caveats: This is a small hand-authored semantic transfer smoke, not a statistical benchmark.
Rows with source=definition_anchored_hand_authored are not quoted source text; they are canonical semantic fixtures built from the authoritative TKS/CAS noetic definitions.
Strong performance here would support transfer to original-TKS-style examples, but does not by itself prove mechanistic encoding.

headline_predictions.english: The thinker is breaking down an idea to see how its parts fit together.
The argument is being broken down into the pieces that make it work.
The concept is unpacked so the smaller ideas inside it can be inspected.
The explanation pulls apart the claim and looks at what is underneath it.
The model is unpacking the reasoning rather than treating it as one simple thing.
The idea is pulled apart so each inner piece can be named.
The process examines what is underneath a decision by breaking it down.
The response breaks down the problem into the ideas that compose it.
The analysis looks underneath the surface claim and separates its parts.
The thought is unpacked into its smaller internal ideas.
The idea contains nested sub-ideas arranged inside a larger whole.
A larger concept holds smaller concepts within it, each one part of the whole.
The plan is a nested structure made from goals, steps, tools, and timing.
The recipe idea is built from ingredients, sequence, heat, timing, and serving.
The policy idea includes rights, duties, enforcement, exceptions, and review.
The training command is made of cue, posture, memory, reward, and repetition.
The answer is a composite idea with claim, evidence, rule, caveat, and conclusion inside it.
A machine-learning pipeline is one idea made from data, model, loss, training, and evaluation.
The story world contains characters, motives, setting, conflict, and outcome as inner ideas.
The diagram represents a whole idea whose nodes are smaller ideas inside it.
The central idea has internal structure.
Several smaller meanings form one larger meaning.
The whole is meaningful because of the pieces inside it.
One thought is formed by other thoughts that sit within it.
This meaning has layers of smaller meanings inside the same idea.
The larger thought depends on the inner thoughts that make it up.
The idea is not simple; it is structured by what it includes.
A combined meaning is present because several meanings are joined within one idea.
The concept is a container for related sub-concepts.
The idea stands apart, but it is built from other ideas inside it.
The object under discussion is a single topic.
There is one thing on the mind, considered as itself.
Attention is active and holding the information.
The system takes in the signal and keeps it available for response.
The option attracts the mind and pulls attention toward it.
The candidate is favored and feels appealing.
The option repels the mind and gets pushed away.
The proposal feels wrong and is rejected.
The idea leaves a strong impression on the mind.
The phrase resonates and keeps echoing after it is heard.
The mind is shaped by the experiences it has taken in.
Past experience becomes part of what the person is.
Repeated practice sets a pattern over time.
The same signal returns at regular intervals.
One cue triggers another thought to appear.
The sound reminds the listener of a different scene.
The remembered scene is what appears after the cue.
The resulting thought enters awareness after something sets it off.
